entry.name: pattrforward
entry.digest: Send any message to a named object
entry.description: Routes messages or selects new message routing destinations according to the messages it receives. You can also use the pattrforward object to route messages directly to a specific inlet of an object exposed by pattr or autopattr objects, and also send messages directly to a subpatcher, abstraction or bpatcher.

attributes.digest: Target object
attributes.description: The word, followed by the patcher name of any object in the patcher hierarchy, sets the target object. messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double-clicking on theobject reveals the current target object in its parent patcher.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Incoming messages to theobject are analyzed. If the first element of the message matches the symbols in0, in1 ... inN, theobject will forward all remaining arguments to a specific inlet of the target object. in0 refers to the leftmost inlet (this is the default behavior of theobject), in1 refers to the inlet to the 2nd inlet from the left, and so on.If the target object is a subpatcher, abstraction or bpatcher, the special element inx can be used to send messages directly to the patcher object (in essence, in order to communicate with a virtualobject associated with the patch).
